mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 94 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park and the air quality is currently moderate at 59.

The City Clerk's Office is wrapping up the I Voted sticker contest where Verona students in grades K-12 submitted original designs. The public voting phase is set to begin on July 28 and will continue through August 7 to determine the four winning designs for our November ballots.

We have a busy schedule ahead! Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, and keep an eye out for trivia nights and the downtown farmer's market starting July 28.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a call regarding a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.
Today is the perfect day for some OREO Cookie Overload. The store is open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
